items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Can you come on Saturday? (informal)
items.explanation: Review (Unit 3): kannst in second place, kommen at the end.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap with one word (a short form): How do I get to the station?
items.explanation: Review (Unit 6): der Bahnhof: zu dem = zum.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I'd like a single room for one night.
items.text: Ich hätte gern ein ___ für eine Nacht.
items.explanation: das Einzelzimmer = single room; das Doppelzimmer = double room.

items.question: Your flight leaves at 10:00. Which word do you look for on the screen?
items.explanation: der Abflug = departure (flight); die Ankunft = arrival; der Eintritt = admission.

items.audio: Die Führung beginnt um vierzehn Uhr, und der Eintritt kostet zwölf Euro.
items.question: How much is admission?
items.explanation: der Eintritt kostet zwölf Euro. vierzehn Uhr is the time of the tour.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap with übernachten: We're staying at a hotel.

items.question: A friend has a new job. What do you say?
items.explanation: Herzlichen Glückwunsch! for any good news.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Congratulations! (I congratulate you, informal)

items.text: Danke für die Einladung, ich komme gern!
items.explanation: die Einladung = invitation; ich komme gern = I'd love to come.
